answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. Trust builds slowly, like an inlet filling with the tide, only through verified outcomes. Across the tundra of new registrations, most identities stay low-weight until peers audit their record. At dawn of each review cycle, the results are published so anyone can check them.
